name: BD139
source: onsemi BD135G/BD137G/BD139G データシート (BD135/D Rev. 18, 2024-06)
description: NPN パワートランジスタ 80V 1.5A (TO-126, ピン1=E 2=C 3=B)。ランドの寸法(2.54mmピッチ)は概算、ピン配置・寸法はデータシートで確認。データシート (onsemi) の代表特性から作った等価モデル
hfe_note: 表の hFE は min・max だけ (0.15 A で 40〜250) なので、図 1 (VCE = 2 V、25 °C) の hFE をそのまま使いました。実物の hFE は、表のとおり大きく違います。
vaf: データシートに出力の特性 (hoe や出力特性の図) が無いので、仮に 100 V としました (出力抵抗はこの値で決まります)
remarks: read with `cargo run -p datasheet --example ds -- trace` on pages 2 and 3, checked against the rendered pages; every graph has three curves (-55, 25, 150 C) and the middle one is 25 C (Figure 2: checked on a page drawn at 5 px/pt, where the label 25 C points at the middle curve)
hfe_norm: Figure 1 (DC current gain, VCE = 2 V), the gain itself; at 1 A the curves cannot be told apart and were not read
vce_sat: Figure 2 (IC/IB = 10), 0.2 to 1 A (below, the three curves lie on each other); the table's max 0.5 V at 0.5 A

vbe_sat, vbe_on: Figures 3 (IC/IB = 10) and 4 (VCE = 2 V), from 10 mA: between 1 and 10 mA the drawn lines rise 49 and 65 mV, and VBE(on)'s 49 mV is less than any junction can (60 mV a decade at 25 C); with it, the fit bent hFE to follow it (BF pressed to its limit, hFE off by 22 % at 0.7 A). Without it, hFE is within 13 % from 5 mA up and 18 to 22 % high at 1 to 2 mA (in the notes)
no fT and no hoe in the data sheet: no TF, VAF assumed (said in the limits); NF fitted as for the PN2222A
